text:
nina: Quick ask — need to schedule a 60m design review for the new streaming-config feature (API + SDK + Console UX). Goal: agree on API shape, SDK ergonomics, and console rollout plan before we cut the RFC. Suggested days next week (Tue/Wed). Need pre-reads and a checklist. Who's available? Links: <https://git.internal/redwood/streaming-config/pulls|PR>, <https://figma.com/file/streaming-config|Figma>

sam: Tue 17:00 UTC (10am PT) works for me, otherwise Wed 18:00 UTC is OK. We should get eng-runtime and devex in the room.

diana: I can demo the flow and walkthrough the console changes. 60m is fine. I'll upload Figma frames + demo script by Mon EOD. @nina do you want a live demo or just screencap?

kevin: Live demo would be great but let's have perf notes and a quick AB plan included. Also need a rate-limit/resilience checklist from eng-sre. I'll add perf baseline to the PR.

riley: Can we confirm staging has the model-routing toggle? If not, we can demo with mocked responses. Also can we record the session for the PMs in APAC?

deploy-bot: CI: demo-branch -> all checks passed ✅. Staging deploy scheduled at 1719480000 (staging-001).

nina: OK, let's poll on three slots: Tue 17:00 UTC / Wed 01:00 UTC / Wed 18:00 UTC. Please react with 👍 for your preferred slot, or reply if none work. Pre-read checklist (upload at least 24h before): PR with API spec, SDK diffs, Figma frames, 3 acceptance tests, short rollout plan.

nina: Quick checklist snippet for pre-read (paste into PR description):

```
- API surface and example requests/responses
- SDK usage examples (sync+async)
- Console mockups and user flow notes
- Performance notes (latency, expected qps)
- Rollout plan and rollback criteria
- Acceptance tests (3 scenarios)
```

sam: 👍 for Tue 17:00 UTC. I'll invite eng-runtime and devex.

kevin: 👍 prefer Tue too. I'll attach a small perf run and the AB plan to the PR by Mon morning.

diana: :thumbsup: uploading Figma + demo script by Mon 9am PT. Live demo if staging toggle is ready, otherwise screencap.

riley: cc @maria-sre — can you validate the runbook bits? Also yes please record (APAC folks will watch later).

nina: Thanks — will send calendar invite once we hit consensus. Recording + notes on the invite. If anyone can't make Tue, reply here and we can do Wed evening as backup. :calendar: :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Meeting invite created: streaming-config design review — Tue 17:00 UTC (invites sent).
